vision: Enable a dreamer to express intent once and receive governed, portable, maintainable implementations across suitable platforms while preserving control and evidence.
currentBarrier: The native Expo phone preview requires a Windows-hosted development server, while the dreamer currently has only an iPhone available.

dreamer.learningWillingness: learn only what is necessary for control and recovery

stopCondition: Stop after one hosted mobile-web adapter, one deterministic decision runtime, and issue-disposition evidence. Do not add another product screen, backend, live AI, payments, authentication, native store deployment, or production certification.

laws.title: Closest Viable Path to Vision
laws.failureMode: Work drifts into locally convenient tasks that do not remove the current vision barrier.
laws.action: Rank plausible routes and select the highest viable evidence-producing route.

laws.title: Dreamer and Environment Fit
laws.failureMode: A technically valid route cannot be operated by the dreamer in the current environment.
laws.action: Assess current device, role, capability, dependencies, ownership, and recovery before selecting a framework.

laws.title: Runtime Honesty
laws.failureMode: Generated or bundled software is represented as physically operated or production validated without evidence.
laws.action: Separate generated, tested, bundled, browser-operated, native-operated, and production-validated claims.

laws.title: Temporary Mobile Route Review
laws.failureMode: A temporary workaround becomes an unexamined permanent architecture.
laws.action: Rerank native and web routes after device evidence or Windows access changes.
